Sweet Corn Soup chings secret
By: ravikumar
Published: Friday, January 19, 2018 - 4:56am

Ingredients




1 Packet Ching's Secret Sweet Corn Soup
4 Cups (800ml) Water

Preparation

1 Step 1: 2 Mix pack content with 4 cups (800ml) of water till there are no loops. 3 Step 2: 4 Bring to boil. Stirring continously. Simmer for 3 minutes. 5 Serve Hot!!

About

Recipe for Sweet Corn Soup is quick and easy to make for your small hunger. It’s very healthy and delicious its make your taste buds. It is one of the best and healthy soup you can have it.
